metadata.title: 80s Pop Portrait with Vertical Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A close-up portrait of a woman with voluminous curly hair wearing denim, featuring a prominent vertical text block on the left margin using a high-contrast serif font.
triggerTerms: vertical serif text on left margin

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a woman looking back over her shoulder, framed by a soft-focus urban background, with a bold vertical typographic element running the full height of the left edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text block balances the subject's rightward gaze
Denim texture contrasts with the soft skin tones and hair curls
Warm skin tones pop against the cool blue of the denim and grey background
The diagonal line of the shoulder leads the eye toward the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the vertical text block on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the vertical text, moves across the shoulder to the face, and follows the gaze back toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft-focus background provides breathing room around the subject's head.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and golden-brown hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and pale yellow in the typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted background saturation allows the subject and high-value text to stand out.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thin horizontal serifs and hairlines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single strong display face used for all text elements.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and condensed nature of the original.
Captures the elegant, high-fashion 80s serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s curls, wearing a denim jacket off one shoulder, looking back at the camera. Background should be a soft-focus urban stone texture. Leave the left 20% of the frame clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical uppercase text in a high-contrast serif font (like Bodoni) along the left edge, running from bottom to top. Use a white-to-yellow gradient fill.

verificationChecks: Does the font have high contrast between thick and thin strokes?
Is the hair voluminous and curly?

postGenerationChecks: Text is legible despite vertical orientation
Skin tones appear natural and warm
Denim texture is visible and detailed
Typography does not obscure the subject's face
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Denim + Voluminous Hair + Left-aligned Vertical High-Contrast Serif
